outcome_rules.positive: all shortcut gates pass and max_statistic_p <= 0.05 and macro_f1_margin_over_surface >= 0.10
outcome_rules.null: all shortcut gates pass and the positive rule is false
outcome_rules.failed: an execution, integrity, identity, or receipt gate fails before a valid statistic
outcome_rules.non_interpretable: any shortcut gate reaches or exceeds its frozen threshold
